components.name: Lossless 12-bit BF16 codec with escapes
components.status: SOURCE_PRESENT; actual applicability is in scored routes
components.implementation: 8-bit low byte plus sign and 3-bit high-byte window delta; choose densest window; XOR escaped high bits restore outliers. Independent unpack verifies all packed weights; per-warp fixed-stride sorted sentinel escape lists.
components.gain_scope: Exact source inclusion and scored package validation; no isolated component causal gain inferred.

components.gain_scope: Exact source inclusion and scored package validation; no isolated component causal gain inferred.

components.name: RS128/RQ swap-AB producer/math pipeline

components.implementation: W compressed12288B perK64 via bulk, X TMA SW128; two mathWGs decoded W asregisterA, XsharedB.
